scope: One data-qualification experiment only; no training authorized or scheduled by this file.
frozen_assets: Reuse V4 original specialist checkpoint hashes and candidate budgets: math 4, coding <=3, physics 9.
freshness: Generate and commit a complete public task/private scorer manifest before candidate inference. Reject exact V4 identities, canonical math states, coding ASTs and physics scene seeds/indices used in the original run. Do not read or select historical sealed holdouts. No observed V4 OOD identity can enter any new split.

minimal_data_corrections.mathematics: Balance incoming=0 and incoming=1 within each split; sample fresh legal states with seed above, retaining fixed top-two digit/carry proposals. Do not expand candidates or inject answers after seeing labels.
minimal_data_corrections.physics: Use new scene seed above and indices 2000..2011; alternate horizons 8 and 16 within both splits. Set target from latest masked public observed position plus offset [(0,0),(0.5,0),(0,0.5),(-0.5,0)][index modulo 4], before rollout or verification. Remove absolute-target/short-horizon mismatch without selecting targets using actual future states.
minimal_data_corrections.coding: Use fresh literals >=101 and fresh task names. Cycle four small repair families: inclusive boundary, exclusive boundary, one-literal error, sum/count contract mismatch. Keep actual Qwen proposals and unchanged control; normalize AST-equivalent duplicates before scoring. Deterministically shuffle candidate order for every condition with task hash, preserving specialist score bindings. No hand-inserted correct repairs.

qualification_gates.integrity: All identities disjoint, candidate features persisted before scores/outcomes, independent candidate replay PASS. Qualification labels are never used for training.

exact_stop_conditions: Stop after at most 36 requests. Any generation, integrity or replay failure stops the experiment.
If any label-mix, oracle or headroom gate fails, preserve DATA_NO_GO; no replacements, larger top-k, new seeds, extra requests or training.
If all gates pass, stop with DATA_READY. Do not train until a separate fresh evaluation manifest and training authorization exist.
Never change the original V4 gates, outcomes or NO_GO decision; this is a new development proposal, not a repaired original experiment.

conditional_later_training_plan.direction: mathematics+physics -> coding only; 9 fits, three original optimizer seeds and B/C/D conditions, unchanged 4865-parameter network and 120x32 updates
conditional_later_training_plan.evaluation: Freeze 16 entirely fresh coding evaluation identities and their scorer before training; no selection by evaluation candidate labels, correctness, or model performance. All 16 remain in denominators. Evaluation must not reuse qualification tasks.
conditional_later_training_plan.gates: At least +2/16 mean correct selections versus each of domain-only and randomized-auxiliary, positive gain for all three seeds, shared target-training Brier improvement >=0.01 over both initialization and constant prevalence for every seed, mean evaluation Brier no worse than either control, and all independent integrity/replay checks pass. Otherwise STOP NO_GO. GO is to independent confirmation only.
conditional_later_training_plan.limits: No all-domain negative-transfer claim from a single target. No retuning, budget expansion or repeat seed search. Exact fresh generator/manifest implementation is still pending.
